**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 22  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly concluded that the film "Joe Palooka in Fighting Mad" had the younger director by comparing the ages of the directors at the time of their respective films' release, rather than determining who was objectively younger based on their birth years. Although the Planner correctly gathered both directors' birth years (Reginald Le Borg – born in 1902 and Hervé Bromberger – born in 1918), the comparison was made based on their ages at the release of the films (1948 for "Joe Palooka in Fighting Mad" and 1972 for "Figaro-ci, Figaro-la") rather than simply who had the later birth year. This led to a misunderstanding of the task, which specifically asked for the younger director overall, not at the time of their work. This misinterpretation of the task requirements caused the Planner to arrive at the incorrect solution.
